lines.en: The internet isn't working. Can you look?
Grandma, the network is off. Let me turn it on.
lines.ko: 할머니, 네트워크가 꺼져 있어요. 제가 켤게요.

lines.en: Thank you. I want to learn to cook soup online.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 온라인으로 국 끓이는 법을 배우고 싶어요.

lines.en: Okay. Which website do you use?
The one I used yesterday. Here is my password.
lines.ko: 어제 쓴 거요. 여기 제 비밀번호예요.

lines.en: Don't show your password to other people, Grandma.
lines.ko: 할머니, 비밀번호는 다른 사람에게 보여주지 마세요.

lines.en: Oh, right. Is my account safe?
Yes. I will make a new password for you.
Please write it down. I will keep it safe.
Good. Now let's look for a soup video.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 이제 국 끓이는 영상을 찾아봐요.

lines.en: Teacher, can you help me send an email?
lines.ko: 선생님, 이메일 보내는 것 좀 도와줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. Do you have an email account?
Yes. My daughter made one for me last month.
Great. Type your password and click here.
I'm in! Now how do I upload a picture?
Click this link, and choose the picture from your file.
lines.ko: 이 링크를 클릭하고 파일에서 사진을 고르세요.

lines.en: I see it. Can I download her pictures too?
lines.ko: 보여요. 딸 사진도 내려받을 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes, when she sends them. It's easy online.
I will send my first email to her tonight.
lines.ko: 오늘 밤 딸에게 첫 이메일을 보낼 거예요.

lines.en: She will be so happy. Well done!
